"MU" most commonly refers to Micron Technology, Inc., a major semiconductor and memory chip company traded on the Nasdaq stock exchange under the ticker symbol MU. 
Other Meanings of "MU" or "μ":
  • Greek Letter (μ / Μ): The 12th letter of the Greek alphabet, pronounced "myoo". 
  • Measurement Prefix: Stands for micro (10⁻⁶ or one-millionth, e.g., μm for micrometer). 
  • Science & Mathematics:
    • In statistics, μ represents the population mean.
    • In physics, it can denote the coefficient of friction, magnetic permeability, or a muon particle. 
  • Universities & Acronyms: Can stand for institutions like the University of Missouri or Mahidol University.
